name: Mekoboro
backstory: Child of Auroboro and Mekestros; grew up around drives a caravan up and down the transit... in Gorff, and knows something of Birth Of Niemornak.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Salthos Mediator Line their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Salthos Mediator Line as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: walks the tollhouse's stretch some mornings at her mother's insistence, listens more than she corrects, still working out which parts of that night's story are worth repeating

arc.premise: Mekoboro wants to find out, by asking the travelers and drivers who actually pass the tollhouse each week, whether the Salthos house was ever really chosen to mediate the crossing or simply never left the ground it stood on - the question her own criterion won't let her set down.
